answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 7184 Country: India Title: Is it necessary to do wazu and read hadees at home? Question: Is it necessary to do wazu and read hadees at home? Answer ID: 7184 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 811/811=M/1429) It is not necessary to make wudhu at home, but it is more reward-able to go to mosque in a state of wudhu. So, one should strive to get this virtue. If one knows Hadith and is aware of Hadith related knowledge, then he can read and teach Hadith at home. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
